message.content:
An editorial magazine cover features a close-up portrait of a man with short, graying hair, visible facial wrinkles, and light-colored skin. He is shown from the chest up, oriented toward the right but looking slightly toward the viewer. His mouth is open as if speaking, and his right hand is raised in the foreground, though it is out of focus. He wears a patterned brown and tan batik shirt.

The background is a solid, neutral gray. Large red capital letters spelling "TEMPO" are partially visible behind the man’s head. White and black text is arranged around the subject. At the bottom right, large white letters read "AGUAN BICARA". Above this, a quote in black reads, “Kami mesti menjaga wajah presiden.” Smaller black text follows, mentioning "Agung Sedayu Group," "Ibu Kota Nusantara," and "proyek strategis nasional."

In the upper right, a barcode, a QR code, and publication details include "9-15 DESEMBER 2024," "RP 50.000," and "ISSN: 0126 - 4273." Additional headlines at the top read "Ambisi Prabowo di Pilkada Sulawesi Utara H.78" and "Buru-buru Makan Bergizi Gratis H.96."
